stage.name: Geared and Ordered
stage.description:
Condition:
All allied units have massively reduced natural SP recovery rate

possessed_soldier_leader.name: Possessed Soldier Leader
possessed_soldier_leader.flavourText: A soldier that has been controlled by an unknown entity, capable of regenerating rapidly and more dangerous than a normal Possessed Soldier. The appearance of such an aberration on the battlefield is almost beyond imagination.

guerrilla_herald.name: Guerrilla Herald
guerrilla_herald.flavourText: Patriot's guerilla fighters employ a special language to communicate and synergize their coordinated operations on the battlefield. The heralds are important links within their communication system. While present, they will issue tactical commands to increase the offensive and defensive abilities of nearby allies.
abilities: Increases the ATK and DEF of enemy units when on the battlefield.

cheering_sponsor_drone.name: Cheering Sponsor Drone
cheering_sponsor_drone.flavourText: Ellen Select Technology thanks you for your heartfelt sponsorship! This drone broadcasts select commercials from the General Chamber of Commerce to knights and spectators at all times, stimulating the crowd and making the competition that much more exciting!
abilities: Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter
Upon death, significantly increase ASPD and DEF of our units on the field for a period.

avenger.name: Avenger
avenger.flavourText: An unidentified combatant who attacks using unconventional methods. Equipped with a special weapon, they are known to change their attack patterns during combat, making them difficult to defend against.
abilities: Gains significantly increased ATK when HP is under 50%

agent.name: Agent
agent.flavourText: A caster who utilizes coordinated tactics. They are able to enhance their melee attacks with Arts damage, and employ a variety of techniques to break through unprepared defenders.
abilities: Attacks temporarily reduce allied units' Block

mudrock_colossus.name: Mudrock Colossus
mudrock_colossus.flavourText: This Originium construct, crafted by Mudrock, does not possess sentience and must be directly controlled by Mudrock. Though bulky and slow, they are extremely durable and boast terrifying physical damage and survivability.
